rows.en:
(Come to think of it, Michel's eyesight is too good,
so he wears glasses to correct it, right?)
Hm? What is it, \p?

Michel, your eyesight's better
with your glasses off, right?
Just how much can you see with the naked eye?

Let's see...
Well, I can count the stars exactly, at least.
Huh~ That's amazing.

But keeping my eyesight in check
actually helps me out, too.
Helps you out?

If I could spot any more beautiful ladies,
I'd end up hitting on even more of them.
These are just right for keeping that in check.

Having eyes that see too much is a real pain
in all kinds of ways, I tell ya.

(Michel... that's not the real reason
he wears corrective glasses, is it?)

(Come to think of it, Michel-kun's eyesight
is too good, so he wears glasses
to correct it, right?)

Michel-kun, your eyesight's better
with your glasses off, right?
Just how much can you see with the naked eye?
Huh~ That's amazing.

(Michel-kun... that's not the real reason
he wears corrective glasses, is it?)

You made fun of me again!
Grr... You'll pay for this! Michel!!

(Klan-senpai and Michel are fighting again...
Come to think of it, what's the deal
between those two?)

Michel, you and Klan-senpai are pretty close.
What's your relationship, anyway?

Me and Klan, close...?
How on earth do you figure that?

I see you two goofing around together
all the time, having fun.

That's not goofing around.
I'm just teasing Klan, that's all.
(Isn't that exactly what goofing around is...?)

Besides, Klan and I are just childhood friends.
I'm always the one looking after her.
Is that so?
Yeah, it is!
O-okay, I get it.

(Michel doesn't have to deny it that hard...
Oh, maybe he's just embarrassed?)

(Klan-senpai and Michel-kun are fighting again...
Come to think of it, what's the deal
between those two?)

Michel-kun, you and Klan-senpai are pretty
close. What's your relationship, anyway?
O-okay, I get it.

(Michel-kun doesn't have to deny it that hard...
Oh, maybe he's just embarrassed?)

\p, sorry!
Hide me for a bit!

Miche~~l!!
Today I'll finally bring you to justice~!!

Uh, Michel...
What on earth did you do to Klan-senpai?
Nothing much. I just teased her a little.
"A little," huh...
Klan's so much fun to tease, I just can't help it.
Michel! So this is where you were!!

Whoops, she found me...
Later, \p.
Get back here~! Michel!!
(Geez, Michel never learns.)

Uh, Michel-kun...
What on earth did you do to Klan-senpai?
(Honestly, Michel-kun never learns.)

(Next is Gary-sensei's Practical Training.
I'd better get ready...)

(Hm?
What's up with Michel, spacing out like that?)

Hey, Michel.
If you don't get ready for the next class,
you'll be late.
Hm? Ah... Right......

What's wrong?
You've been spacing out this whole time.

It's nothing.
I was just thinking about my sister...
rows.notes: nee-san (kinship): 'my sister'; the player's reply in c18236 makes it 'older sister'.

rows.en:
Your sister?
You have an older sister, Michel?

Sorry, \p...
Tell Gary-sensei I'm skipping
Practical Training today.
Huh?! Oh, hey, Michel...

(First I've ever heard of Michel having a sister...
What's gotten into him......?)

(Next is Gary-sensei's Practical Training.
I'd better get ready...)

(Hm?
What's up with Michel-kun,
spacing out like that?)

Hey, Michel-kun.
If you don't get ready for the next class,
you'll be late.

What's wrong?
You've been spacing out this whole time.

Your sister?
You have an older sister, Michel-kun?
Huh?! Oh, wait, Michel-kun...

(First I've ever heard of Michel-kun having
a sister... What's gotten into him......?)
Grr... Knock it off already! Michael!!
You need something, \p?

Michel, you and Alto get along great.
How long have you two known each other?

I'd love to hear exactly how you figure
we get along, but...
I met Alto right before we graduated junior high.

Alto came storming into the Pilot Course
out of nowhere, wearing a pretty dress.
Seriously, he looked like nothing but a girl.
Well, we've been stuck with each other ever since.
Huh~ So that's how it was.

(So that's how they met...
Maybe that's why Alto's always picking fights
with Michel...)

Michel-kun, you and Saotome-kun get along
great. How long have you two known each other?
Huh~ So that's how it was.

(So that's how they met...
Maybe that's why Saotome-kun
is always picking fights with Michel-kun...)

uncertain: c18235/c18236: nee-san translated 'my sister' / 'an older sister' (kinship word translated per brief).
c18206/c18207/c18208: jareau rendered 'goofing around' so the player's retort in c18208 echoes it.
